summary: Loma Negra Compania Industrial Argentina S.A., an Argentine cement producer listed on NYSE, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited consolidated condensed interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, prepared under IAS 29 inflation accounting. Net revenues rose to ARS 471.6bn from ARS 464.0bn, gross profit slipped to ARS 106.6bn, and net profit attributable to owners reached ARS 51.2bn. The filing is a routine periodic report, not a special situation; no transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated.
